messages:
maria: quick heads-up — did a short sweep comparing PCIe vs SXM for the 13B bring-up (int8 quant, e2e generation). ran in us-east1 (PCIe 40G) and us-west1 (SXM 80G). sharing top-line before i sleep:

maria: summary numbers:
- PCIe (40G, single-socket): p50=98ms, p95=210ms, throughput=22 tok/s
- SXM (80G, NVLink on): p50=82ms, p95=170ms, throughput=34 tok/s
- PCIe + numa pin: p50 improved ~10% (88ms) but p95 roughly same
- SXM + nvlink-agg kernel: throughput +1.3x but tail slipped ~5%

maria: command I used:
```
bench run --model redwood/13b-int8 --tokens 2048 --batch 1 --gpu-type A100 --topo pci/sxm --kernel=cutlass,triton --numa-bind=0
```

ashwin: nice. did you test with kv-cache sharing across GPUs or independent per-replica?

maria: independent per-replica for these runs. i tried a tiny kv-shared experiment on SXM — latency improved another ~6% but it required explicit NVLink mapping (kernel-level).

jess: can you paste the kernel flags? curious which triton variant.

maria: ```--kernel=cutlass_fused --slice=auto --nvlink-agg=true --quant=int8-gptq```

tim: fyi, on PCIe the nvlink-agg flag is a no-op (no nvlink) and actually caused extra memcpy paths in the runtime we hadn't optimized, which explains the worse tail. we pushed a small runtime guard yesterday to avoid the memcpy fallback — re-run should keep tail from regressing.

ashwin: do you have the p2p topology? sometimes PCIe boxes have local NVLink between certain sockets (weird setups).

maria: pasted infra output:
```
Node0: GPU0 <-> GPU1: PCIe (P2P ok)
Node0: GPU1 <-> GPU2: NVLink (link up)
Node0: GPU2 <-> GPU3: NVLink
```

maria: so this cluster is mixed; explains why pinning helped on some hosts.

jess: region note — us-west1 runs on a slightly newer kernel/driver stack; we see better cutlass kernels there. might be driver-level fused gemm improvements.

bench-bot: automated chart uploaded: https://internal/bench/1869004321/chart (p50/p95 + throughput by kernel/gpu/region) :bar_chart:

tim: action items:
- re-run PCIe with runtime guard (i fixed) and collect tail histograms (ashwin volunteered) :+1:
- try KV-shared on PCIe hosts where NVLink exists between a subset of GPUs (maria)
- add cuBLAS-fused kernel baseline (jess)

ashwin: i'll collect p2p logs and try a pin mapper script to prefer NVLink pairs for multi-gpu slices. should reduce cross-socket PCIe hops.

maria: thanks — i'll queue the re-runs tomorrow morning and attach raw traces (latency hist, nvlink counters, pci counters). any other obs?

jess: also include quantization quality evals — we saw a small decode drift with int8-gptq + cutlass fused on longer prompts. add the regression suite.

maria: added to the run plan. good call. night! :zzz:
